Facts: The defendant fabricated traffic accidents between his car and others, to claim insurance money. This is fraud using false accident claims. Does it fall under contract fraud? The label list includes "诈骗". The correction lessons mention that if there is also other crimes like selling blood, etc. Not relevant.

Thus label: 诈骗.
